_about: Mood boards. The host chooses every image. To add one, put the file in src/assets/moodboards/<board id>/ and list it under that board with its file name, alt text and optional caption. Until images are supplied, each board shows the placeholder plates listed in "placeholders" (shape only).

boards.title: The Velvet Cellar
boards.subtitle: The overall aesthetic
boards.note: Underground speakeasies, champagne towers, candlelight, burgundy velvet, jazz clubs, card tables and Art Deco interiors.

boards.title: The Ladies of The Velvet Cellar
boards.subtitle: Costume inspiration
boards.note: Glamorous eveningwear, flapper dresses, satin and velvet, beading, pearls, long gloves, feathers, sharp tailoring and a little femme fatale.

boards.title: The Gentlemen of The Velvet Cellar
boards.subtitle: Costume inspiration
boards.note: Three-piece suits, black tie, pinstripes, waistcoats, suspenders and bow ties, fedoras and flat caps, pocket watches, gamblers and gangsters.
